demo.subtitulo: Five exercises drawn by our own engine. Development only.
demo.sinSustituto: There's no other exercise from this group in the test catalog yet.

cues.pie: The bar goes down and up over mid-foot.
cues.rodillas: Knees in line with your toes.
cues.profundidad: Go down until your hip passes your knee, if you can keep your back straight.
cues.espalda: Chest up and neutral back the whole way.

errores.lumbar: Rounding your lower back at the bottom.
errores.rodillasDentro: Letting your knees cave in on the way up.

cues.apoyos: Feet flat on the floor; glutes and upper back on the bench.
cues.escapulas: Pull your shoulder blades together and down before unracking.
cues.trayectoria: Lower to your lower chest with vertical forearms.
cues.seguridad: With heavy loads, use safety pins or a spotter.

errores.codos: Flaring your elbows to 90° from your torso.
errores.rebote: Bouncing the bar off your chest.
errores.gluteos: Lifting your glutes off the bench.

cues.apoyo: Hand and knee on the bench; the other foot firm on the floor.
cues.codo: Drive your elbow toward your hip, close to your body.
cues.tronco: Flat back: your torso doesn't twist as you pull.

errores.giro: Twisting your torso to lift more weight.
errores.biceps: Pulling with your biceps instead of your elbow.
errores.cuello: Lifting your head and arching your neck.

cues.codos: Elbows still, close to your body.
cues.recorrido: Full range: almost straight at the bottom, closed at the top.
cues.bajada: Lower slowly, over about two seconds.

errores.balanceo: Swinging your torso to lift the weight.
errores.codosDelante: Moving your elbows forward on the way up.

cues.linea: Shoulders, hips and ankles in a straight line.
cues.abdomen: Brace your abs and glutes and keep breathing.
